## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->
The repository provides an OpenAPI 3.1.0 plugin for RxDB Server that automatically creates an OpenAPI specification from the server’s REST endpoint collection schemas. It offers pure functions like generateOpenApiSpec and generateOpenApiJson to produce the spec object or JSON string without side effects. The createOpenApiMiddleware function returns an Express-compatible middleware that serves the spec at /openapi.json, making integration with existing Express apps straightforward. By using endpointFromCollection, developers can easily convert live RxCollection instances into the required endpoint configuration. This tool helps backend developers quickly generate client libraries, documentation, or API contracts for their RxDB‑powered APIs, reducing manual effort.
